description: Perfect for smaller spaces or grandparents' homes, the Mini Newport comes complete with a mattress and rolling casters for easy mobility. This compact crib offers the same solid hardwood construction and warm Brown Maple finish as the full-sized Newport, in a space-saving design that fits beautifully in any room. Great for naps, travel, or as a first crib in a nursery where space is at a premium. Converts to a toddler bed with the included conversion pieces. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish. Meets all CPSC and ASTM safety standards.
